headline: LODE RUNNER-LITE: phones pick their own vault
lede: The marquee now carries tappable VAULT 1/2/3 pads — the phone finally reaches the vaults the keyboard always could, and the honest-classic chain (die on vault 2, restart at 1) stands untouched.

notes.text: Three pads dispatch the same Digit1/2/3 the keyboard path uses, sized ≥44x28 for thumbs; lodeplay taps each pad's real centre and grades that it opens its OWN vault — a neutered button-guard mutant fell through to vault 1 and went red exactly there.

Prod verification learned three silent-empty traps the same day: the chunk manifest lives inside the entry JS, /retrogames/assets/* answers 308 (curl needs -L), and this box's egress proxy can return XML instead of the site. An empty scan is a failed scan.

The never-dry audit closed one loop and opened another: two LODE RUNNER README 'gaps' were shipped work missing CLOSED markers — honesty markers landed with the fix, so the shelf stops re-kicking lanes onto closed work.

WATCH b31 (slot a, same shift): SUPER MARIO seats its proven autopilot and the full-shelf driver audit closes the #1637 saga — every registry title either carries the Y line or says no guide truthfully.
